title: Forgive Us, Shiori, For We Have Sinned

lines.en: "Sister Shiori, I have a confession to make. Three days ago, on my way home from work at 11 PM..."
lines.ja: 「シスターシオリ、懺悔します」 「3日前の午後11時、仕事からの帰り道」

lines.en: Well, it's no longer three days ago. I got these confessions from like a week ago or something.
lines.ja: 「いやもっと前…」「1週間ほど抱え続けています…」

lines.en: "I was so exhausted from overtime, that I took an empty priority seat on the train.
lines.ja: 「残業で疲れていた私は」「電車の優先席に座ってしまいました」

lines.en: "I know I shouldn't have done so as a fully capable healthy adult,
lines.ja: 「私のように健康な大人が 座るべきでないのにです」

lines.en: but the train was almost empty. "And that night, I just couldn't stand anymore.
lines.ja: 「電車内はガラガラで」「あの時は私の足も限界でした」

lines.en: "I kept looking around feeling guilty, but no one seemed to need it at that moment.
lines.ja: 「罪悪感もあって周りを見ましたが」「優先席が必要そうな人はいませんでした」

lines.en: "Still, I feel bad about it, Sister. "Please forgive me for my selfishness."
lines.ja: 「でも今は後悔しています」「私の身勝手をお許しください」

lines.en: FORGIVEN! I've done it too, let's gooo! Wheeee!
lines.ja: 許す！ 私もやったことあるし！
私もやったことあるわ

lines.en: But, unlike you, there were people around.
lines.ja: 私の時はガラガラじゃなかったけど

lines.en: But, you see, I don't think anyone needed it at the time.
lines.ja: 優先席が必要そうな人はいなかったわ

lines.en: If I saw a pregnant lady or an old woman, yes, I would give them my seat.
lines.ja: 妊婦さんやお年寄りがいたら 私も譲るわよ

lines.en: I have done so, because I felt bad. But if there's no one around, I'mma take it.
lines.ja: さすがにそれは悪いからね でも誰も座らないなら私が座るわ

notes.meaning: I'm going to のくだけた発音を表す言い方

lines.en: Because Sister Shiori believes in equality.
lines.ja: だってシスターシオリの信条は「平等」

lines.en: I believe in equality. I believe in first come, first serve.
lines.ja: 平等であり… 早い者勝ちよ

lines.en: If someone desperately needs it, yes, of course, we'll give it.
lines.ja: 他に必要な人がいれば当然譲るしね

lines.en: I think that you are too pure and I need to corrupt you.
lines.ja: あなたはピュアすぎるわ 私が悪い子にしてあげる

lines.en: I need to make it so you never feel guilt about it again.
lines.ja: もうそのことで 罪悪感を覚えないようにね…！
